| Syntax | startOfWeek() where inc is an optional increment of(+/-)nn(y\|M\|w\|d\|h\|m) . If the time unit qualifier is omitted, it defaults to the natural period of the function, e.g.startOfWeek("+1") is the same asstartOfWeek("+1w") . If the plus/minus(+/-) sign is omitted, plus(+) is assumed. | 
|---|---|
| Supported fields | Created, Due, Resolved, Updated, custom fields of type Date/Time | 
| Supported operators | = ,!= ,> ,>= ,< ,<= ,WAS ,WAS IN ,WAS NOT ,WAS NOT IN ,CHANGED | 
| Unsupported operators | ~ ,!~ ,IS ,IS NOT ,IN ,NOT IN | 
| Examples |  | 
startOfYear()
Perform searches based on the start of the current year.
See also startOfDay(), startOfWeek(), startOfMonth(), endOfDay(), endOfWeek(), endOfMonth() and endOfYear().
